name: Stack Ratio Lock
description: Keep the aspect ratio of layers inside stacks when the stack changes width.
author: Jorge Medrano

commands.name: Toggle Ratio Lock
commands.description: Lock or unlock the aspect ratio of the selected layers inside stacks

commands.name: Set Width…
commands.description: Resize the selected layers and update the locked ratios inside them

commands.name: Update Ratios
commands.description: Restore locked ratios in the selection, or on the whole page
